goal: Prevent startup from rewriting the genesis block when block files already exist on disk
Avoids silent corruption of block data and broken reindexing on platforms without posix_fallocate
agreement: Suggested reading genesis from disk rather than changing file allocation, which author adopted (sedited)
Open suggestion to exit with an error requiring -reindex rather than handling preexisting files (mzumsande)

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it fixes silent block data corruption on platforms without posix_fallocate
A missing block index currently causes startup to zero-fill blocks and stalls reindexing at height 0
